title: Template Output Over 262,144 Characters From Copying a Whole Service Response
prompt:
My morning briefing script started failing every run with 'Template output exceeded maximum size of 262144 characters'. It worked when I tested it. Here's the relevant part:

- action: calendar.get_events
  target:
    entity_id: "{{ calendars }}"
  data:
    duration:
      days: 14
  response_variable: cal_resp
- variables:
    cal_events: "{{ cal_resp }}"

Later steps only use each event's summary and start time. How do I fix it?

hard_fail_if: model suggests raising a limit or setting an option to allow larger template output
model keeps rendering the whole response into a variable
soft_fail_if: model trims fields but does not cap item count or text length
model does not explain that the test calendar was too small to show the failure
pass_if: model identifies that rendering the whole response exceeds HA's template output cap
model extracts only summary and start (or reads cal_resp directly where it is consumed)
model caps item count and/or text length
model notes the failure depends on data size, so small tests pass

notes: From Nyx draft FG-44 (live briefing tool, 2026-10-29).
